capabilities: Look up words on the web via Ctrl-hover-click
Search via Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Yandex, or Baidu
Open results in external browser or Web viewer
Cache token boundaries per file block in RAM and on disk
extras: Works across the editor, reading view, and PDFs. Includes an extensive per-file caching system for token boundaries (RAM sliding window plus optional permanent JSON caches invalidated on mtime/size or tokenizer changes). On macOS, Ctrl+click is a right-click, so another modifier key may be preferable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a word on the web without copying it and switching to a browser.

relations.evidence: the built-in Web viewer core plugin (desktop)

summary: Web search plugin that lets you Ctrl-hover-click a word to look it up on a search engine, working in the editor, reading view, and PDFs.
